prs.title: fix: respect disabled listChanged capabilities on v1.x
prs.author: paulelliotco
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: McpServer ignores explicit `listChanged: false` capability settings — registering a tool/resource/prompt unconditionally fires list-changed notifications regardless of what was set at construction time. (2 PRs)
prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: McpServer ignores explicit `listChanged: false` capability settings — registering a tool/resource/prompt unconditionally fires list-changed notifications regardless of what was set at construction time. (2 PRs)
prs.cluster_pick_reason: PR #1948 is a strict superset of #1937's code changes. The `mcp.ts` diffs are identical (same blob hashes 9fe0ed549→cf4617328), and both promote `getCapabilities()` to public. But #1948 additionally guards `sendResourceListChanged`, `sendToolListChanged`, and `sendPromptListChanged` in `index.ts` so notifications are suppressed at the send layer when the capability is disabled — a defence-in-depth fix that #1937 lacks. The only thing #1937 adds that #1948 does not is the `.changeset` file, which can be ported over before merging #1948.
